records.title: CHICAGO AREA SIAM STUDENT CONFERENCE
records.summary: A two-day regional gathering bringing students and researchers together for national-laboratory visits, talks, scientific discussion, new connections, and a little bowling and symphony.
records.history: The 2024 Chicago Area SIAM Student Conference was held jointly with the SPS Zone 9 Meeting and brought together students from more than ten universities. Day 1 sent attendees to Fermilab and Argonne National Laboratory before everyone reconvened for dinner and an evening at The Bog. Day 2 continued at Illinois Tech with talks and discussion spanning applied mathematics, physics, machine learning, uncertainty quantification, and scientific computing, before concluding at the Chicago Symphony Orchestra.

program.title: PUTTING MATH AT THE FOUNDATIONS OF MACHINE LEARNING
program.speaker: Carlo Graziani
program.description: A discussion of the mathematical foundations of machine learning, its historical development, and challenges including hallucination and explainability.

program.title: REGIONAL STUDENT LUNCH
program.description: Lunch was organized to encourage students to meet researchers and students from institutions across the region and continue conversations about greater collaboration among Chicagoland students.

program.title: REFLECTING UPON A CENTURY OF NOETHER'S THEOREM
program.speaker: Chris Quigg
program.description: A discussion of Emmy Noether, conservation laws, symmetry, and the continuing significance of Noether's theorems in physics.

program.title: THE PRESENT & FUTURE OF MATH, PHYSICS, AND ML
program.description: A discussion of major problems spanning mathematics, physics, and machine learning, including the shared challenge of uncertainty quantification.

program.title: UNIVERSALITY & EXACTNESS OF THE MAXWELL EQUATIONS
program.speaker: Robert S. Eisenberg
program.affiliation: Rush Medical College / Illinois Institute of Technology
program.description: A talk connecting mathematical formulations of Maxwell's equations with problems across physics and biology.

records.title: INVOLVEMENT FAIR
records.summary: The chapter welcomed students at Illinois Tech's Winter Involvement Fair and shared ways to get involved with SIAM.
records.history: In January 2026, the Illinois Tech SIAM student chapter participated in the Winter Involvement Fair, meeting students and sharing information about the chapter and its upcoming activities. Chapter president Leonardo and marketing team member Abigail were documented representing SIAM at the chapter table.

records.title: ILLINOIS TECH'S FIRST INTEGRATION BEE
records.summary: Illinois Tech's first Integration Bee invited students to put their calculus skills to the test in an MIT-inspired integration competition.
records.history: On February 7, 2026, the Illinois Tech SIAM student chapter hosted the university's first Integration Bee. Students were invited to compete—or come to spectate—in a calculus competition inspired by MIT's Integration Bee, with prizes for the winners.

records.title: DODGSON'S TEA PARTY
records.summary: Dodgson's Tea Party returned as a weekly Monday gathering for snacks, drinks, mathematics, and conversation.
records.history: During the Spring 2026 semester, the Illinois Tech SIAM student chapter hosted Dodgson's Tea Party on Mondays from 12:45–1:45 PM in PS 121. The recurring gathering invited students to stop by during lunch for snacks, drinks, and conversation.

records.title: PI DAY TRIVIA EVENT
records.summary: A special edition of Dodgson's Tea Party celebrating Pi Day with trivia, pie, food, and prizes.
records.history: On March 9, 2026, the chapter held a special edition of Dodgson's Tea Party in honor of Pi Day. Students gathered in PS 121 for a lunchtime trivia competition with food, pie, and prizes.

records.title: LUNCH WITH A PROFESSOR
records.summary: A two-part lunch series inviting students to meet Illinois Tech mathematics professors outside the classroom.
records.history: In March 2026, the Illinois Tech SIAM student chapter hosted two Lunch With a Professor gatherings. The lunchtime series gave students an informal opportunity to meet mathematics faculty outside the classroom, with Professor Lane featured on March 24 and Professor Bielecki on March 31.

records.title: SOCIAL NIGHT
records.summary: An evening chapter social bringing students together for food, games, and conversation.
records.history: On March 31, 2026, the Illinois Tech SIAM student chapter hosted a Social Night in the Pritzker Club. The evening gathering offered students a chance to spend time together outside the chapter's regular daytime activities, with food and games from 5–8 PM.

records.title: PUTNAM INFORMATION SESSION
records.summary: An introduction to the William Lowell Putnam Mathematical Competition led by Illinois Tech student Leonardo Marciaga, who shared his experience placing in the top 500 and discussed strategies for approaching the notoriously difficult exam.
records.history: Illinois Tech SIAM hosted a Putnam information session for students interested in competitive mathematics. Leonardo Marciaga, an Illinois Tech student who had placed among the top 500 Putnam competitors, introduced the competition and discussed his experience preparing for and taking the exam. The lunchtime session combined practical advice about the Putnam with an informal opportunity for students to meet one another over food.

records.title: SOCIAL NIGHT
records.summary: A joint SIAM IIT and SPS IIT social night with games, food, music, and activities at the MTCC Pritzker Club.
records.history: SIAM IIT and the Society of Physics Students opened the semester with a joint social night at the MTCC Pritzker Club. Students gathered for games including poker, Monopoly, Mario Kart, Cards Against Humanity, Catan, Trivial Pursuit, and Minecraft, with ramen provided for dinner.

records.title: LUNCH WITH A PROFESSOR: IGOR CIALENCO
records.summary: An informal lunch with Professor Igor Cialenco giving students an opportunity to talk about mathematics, research, and academic life outside the classroom.
records.history: SIAM IIT hosted Professor Igor Cialenco for the semester's first Lunch with a Professor. The series was designed to give students an informal setting to speak with faculty outside the classroom about mathematics, research, and academic life.

records.title: MACHINE LEARNING IN FINANCE
records.summary: A joint ML@IIT and SIAM IIT event featuring Professor Benjamin Van Vliet on applications of machine learning to finance.
records.history: SIAM IIT collaborated with ML@IIT for a talk by Professor Benjamin Van Vliet of the Stuart School of Business. The event explored the intersection of machine learning and finance, with an emphasis on prediction and the use of computational methods in financial applications.

records.title: LET'S COLOR!
records.summary: Illinois Tech alumnus Professor Jeff Mudrock presented an undergraduate-accessible talk on the history, applications, and current research of graph coloring.
records.history: SIAM IIT welcomed Illinois Tech alumnus Jeff Mudrock, then an assistant professor at the University of South Alabama, for a talk on graph coloring. Mudrock discussed the development of graph coloring since the nineteenth century, applications in computer science, scheduling, networks, and resource allocation, and contemporary questions in list coloring.

records.title: LUNCH WITH A PROFESSOR: KIAH WAH ONG
records.summary: The second Lunch with a Professor of the semester featured Professor Kiah Wah Ong for an informal conversation with students.
records.history: Following the first Lunch with a Professor earlier in the semester, SIAM IIT continued the series with Professor Kiah Wah Ong of Illinois Tech's Department of Applied Mathematics. Students met with Ong over lunch in an informal setting outside the classroom.

records.title: MENTORSHIP SCHEDULING SESSION
records.summary: A peer mentorship session helping mathematics, statistics, and data science students plan their summer and fall course schedules.
records.history: During course registration, SIAM IIT hosted a peer scheduling session for students in mathematics, statistics, and data science. Students could ask questions about electives, workload, course selection, and planning their upcoming summer and fall schedules with fellow students.

records.title: MENGER DAY UNDERGRADUATE CAREER PANEL
records.summary: An undergraduate career panel on transferable skills for mathematicians, statisticians, and data scientists, held as part of the 14th Annual Menger Day Celebration.
records.history: SIAM IIT and ML@IIT hosted an undergraduate career panel during Illinois Tech's 14th Annual Menger Day Celebration. Students heard from peers, faculty, Ph.D. students, organization leaders, and Menger Lecturer George Karniadakis about research experience, campus involvement, STEM careers, and communicating mathematical skills beyond the classroom.

records.title: MIDWEST PHYSICS & MATH CONFERENCE
records.summary: A three-day regional physics and mathematics conference at Illinois Tech organized by SIAM IIT and SPS IIT.
records.history: SIAM IIT and SPS IIT organized the Midwest Physics & Math Conference at Illinois Tech from April 12–14, bringing together the SPS Zone 9 Meeting and the Chicago Area SIAM Student Conference. The joint event connected students across mathematics and physics and included opportunities to visit major national research laboratories in the Chicago area.

records.title: NATIONAL LABORATORY TOURS
records.summary: Conference participants visited Fermilab and Argonne National Laboratory as part of the joint SPS Zone 9 Meeting and Chicago Area SIAM Student Conference.
records.history: As part of the Midwest Physics & Math Conference, participants were invited to tour Fermilab and Argonne National Laboratory. The trips exposed students to major research facilities spanning particle physics, accelerator science, computing, engineering, materials science, biology, artificial intelligence, and other areas of scientific research.

records.title: LATEX GRAPHICS WORKSHOP
records.summary: The second workshop in SIAM IIT's LaTeX series taught students how to create and incorporate graphics, tables, graphs, and charts into mathematical documents.
records.history: SIAM IIT continued its LaTeX workshop series with a session devoted to graphics. Students learned techniques for adding and creating graphics, tables, graphs, and charts for mathematical and technical documents, with the workshop designed so students could participate even if they had missed the first session.

records.title: MY FAVORITE THEOREM: APPLICATIONS OF FOURIER SERIES
records.summary: SIAM IIT president Mikhail Hall presented the first My Favorite Theorem talk of the fall semester on the history, theory, controversy, and applications of Fourier series.
records.history: SIAM IIT launched its fall My Favorite Theorem series with a student-led lecture by chapter president Mikhail Hall. The presentation traced Fourier series from their historical origins through the heat equation and mathematical controversy surrounding the theory to modern applications.

records.title: SOCIAL NIGHT
records.summary: A joint SIAM IIT and SPS IIT social night with food, board games, and music.
records.history: SIAM IIT and SPS IIT held their first joint social night of the fall semester at the MTCC Pritzker Club. The evening brought students together for food, board games, music, and informal conversation.

records.title: MENTORSHIP SESSION
records.summary: A Dodgson's Tea Party session devoted to peer advising and course scheduling for mathematics, statistics, and data science students.
records.history: SIAM IIT used its weekly Dodgson's Tea Party as a peer mentorship session during registration season. Students in mathematics, statistics, and data science could discuss upcoming courses and build their schedules with fellow students.
